Added pure helpers validateHabitName/moveInArray in lib/habits.ts with unit tests; all three gate commands pass.", "notes_for_reviewer": "While verifying interactively I found and fixed a real bug: sequential awaited calls to the pre-existing renameHabit then recolorHabit both closed over the same stale `habits` snapshot, so the second call's write silently reverted the rename (an edit that changes name+colour together would lose the name). Fixed by adding `updateHabit(id, name, color)` to state.ts that updates both fields in one setHabits/putHabit call, and App.tsx now calls that instead of chaining the two single-field setters. renameHabit/recolorHabit are left in state.ts unused (like the existing deleteHabit precedent) in case a future task wants single-field updates — flagging in case you'd rather trim them. Export JSON/Import buttons were deliberately left out of the footbar per the task text ('added by the next task')." }
